blocks.text: I used to call the old staircase a wall. Grandfather paused on every landing, and I saw each pause as an obstacle keeping us from the roof. Grandfather’s pauses had always come beside an open door: a ladle tapping a pot, a child sounding out a word, someone asking whether we needed water. I now call that same staircase a string of doorways. Its steps are as steep as before.
